heading: Fact model — slot type restrictions
text:
### Fact model — slot type restrictions [LNLS.4.6]

Overlays [LFAC.X] (slot type declarations) and schema slot type
semantics.

Under `linear_scan: false`:
- `json` as a slot type is a compile error (LNLS.3.1).
- `String` slots are allowed.  Slots used in string operations
  (ordering, regex) must carry `capacity N`
  (LNLS.3.10 / LNLS.3.7).  Slots used only for `==`/`!=` or as alpha-test literals
  do not require `capacity`.
- Numeric slots (`Int`, `Float`) with `tolerance` markers are allowed.
- `Bool`, `Bytes`, fact-ref types — unrestricted.
